title: Change your default currency
description: Quick XRP Mobile tutorial: change the app's default currency from Settings and watch every balance follow. The selector shows each currency's code, name and symbol, and the search matches names too, so switching takes seconds. Your holdings never change, only what they are priced in.
lede: Tired of converting in your head every time you open your wallet? Put your own currency on the balance instead, and watch everything you hold follow it.

steps.caption: This wallet prices in dollars
steps.body: Here is a wallet holding XRP, Dogecoin and a stablecoin, and every one of them is priced in US dollars. Say dollars are not your money.

steps.caption: Open Settings
steps.body: Tap the gear. Everything that changes how the app looks to you lives under General, and the current currency is right there on the row.

steps.caption: Code, name and symbol
steps.body: Each row gives you the code, the name and the symbol, so there is no guessing between the dozens of currencies that share a dollar sign.

steps.caption: Search by name, not just code
steps.body: The search matches names too. Type yen instead of J P Y and it still finds it. Tap the one you want.

shots.alt: Search by name, not just code

steps.caption: Back to the balance
steps.body: And this is the part worth seeing: go back to your wallet.

steps.caption: Everything follows
steps.body: Same coins, same amounts, priced in yen. Your holdings never changed: three XRP is still three XRP. Only the money you read them in did.
